Interface Sync<F>

All Superinterfaces:
Applicative<F>, ApplicativeError<F, Throwable>, Bracket<F, Throwable>, Functor<F>, Monad<F>, MonadError<F, Throwable>
All Known Subinterfaces:
Async<F>, Concurrent<F>, ConcurrentEffect<F>, Effect<F>
All Known Implementing Classes:
Instances.CallableInstances, IO.IOConcurrent
public interface Sync<F> extends Bracket<F, Throwable>
Can suspend side effects: delay(() -> println(...)) describes the print, doesn't do it.
